title: Prove the diagrams rendered and read as one set
description:
## Objective
The build exit code proves nothing about Mermaid. Check the screen, then check consistency.

## Spec Reference
`.devmeta/projects/2026-08-13-diagram-verify/2026-08-13-diagram-verify-spec.md` — Sections 1-2

## Implementation
1. Run the dev server, load slides 4, 10 and 14. Each must show a diagram, not an error box.
2. Grep the built bundle for each diagram's node labels.
3. Check the set: consistent label style, no diagram over 8 nodes, no label over 4 words, deck terminology.

## Tests
Run: `cd slides && npm run build` then `cd slides && npm run slides`.
acceptance_criteria: all three diagrams render; set is consistent
closed_reason: all three diagrams render; set is consistent; recorded with viewBoxes and labels
